project: ECG Anomaly Detection using LSTM Autoencoder with Temporal Attention Analysis
deployed_explainability: Post-hoc temporal focus weights derived from pointwise absolute reconstruction error. These are not trained model-attention weights.
clean_retraining_architecture: The optional retraining module includes a trainable temporal attention pooling layer.
threshold_method: Mean training-normal MAE plus three standard deviations
medical_disclaimer: Educational portfolio demonstration only. Not a medical diagnostic tool and not for clinical decisions.
